calls.statement:
SELECT s.store_id, s.store_name, cs.sqm, round(sum(n.v),0) AS net_sales
FROM (
 SELECT f.store_key, f.net_amount v FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-04-28' AND DATE '2026-04-26' AND p.category<>'ZZ Test'
 UNION ALL
 SELECT r.store_key, -r.refund_net FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=r.product_key WHERE r.return_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-04-28' AND DATE '2026-04-26' AND p.category<>'ZZ Test') n
JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=n.store_key
JOIN dim_store cs ON cs.store_id=s.store_id AND cs.is_current
WHERE s.store_id<900 GROUP BY 1,2,3 ORDER BY 4 DESC LIMIT 14
